title: Eight-FE-model range of L1-L5 total ROM under 7.5 Nm pure moments (Dreischarf 2014)

quantity.name: ROM (FE model predictions)
quantity.definition: total L1-L5 rotation (flexion+extension, left+right LB, left+right AR) at 7.5 Nm predicted by 8 published FE models: median and min-max across models. NOT experimental data.

source.authors: Dreischarf M, Zander T, Shirazi-Adl A, Puttlitz CM, Adam CJ, Chen CS, Goel VK, Kiapour A, Kim YH, Labus KM, Little JP, Park WM, Wang YH, Wilke HJ, Rohlmann A, Schmidt H
source.sample: eight published, validated L1-L5 FE models from 8 centres (anonymised Models 1-8)

protocol.summary: Pure moments 7.5 Nm in three planes, no preload; L5 fixed (models 3 and 4 include L5-S1 and are fixed at S1).
how_to_simulate: Apply 7.5 Nm pure moment to L1 in flexion, extension, left/right LB, left/right AR, no preload
Report total L1-L5 rotation per plane (sum of both directions)
protocol.notes: Text: FE median 34 deg (24-41) flexion-extension, 35 (25-41) LB, 17 (11-22) AR. Digitised per-model totals (deg): FE M1 35.7, M2 38.9, M3 31.6, M4 40.6, M5 35.3, M6 24.3, M7 25.5, M8 27.2; LB M1 36.9, M2 34.5, M3 41.0, M4 36.9, M5 30.4, M6 25.1, M7 36.1, M8 32.8; AR M1 16.6, M2 17.8, M3 17.4, M4 11.7, M5 21.9, M6 14.6, M7 19.4, M8 11.3 (+/-1 deg). Values in data[] are the text values (table-like precision); digitised medians 33.3/35.3/17.0. Figures in the QUT eprints author version are low-resolution embedded bitmaps (~550x420 px for a 4-panel figure); digitised by pixel analysis of the extracted image against gridlines.

extraction.from: Section 3.2 text (median and range); Fig 2a for per-model bars
extraction.uncertainty: text values rounded to 1 deg; per-model digitised +/-1 deg
extraction.check_notes: Text values copied from Results 3.2. Digitised per-model values reproduce them: medians 33.45/35.3/17.0 and min-max 24.3-40.6/25.1-41.0/11.3-21.9.

pass_rule.rule: PASS = inside in vitro range (Rohlmann 2001b) AND inside 8-model range; MARGINAL = one of the two
